definitions.explanation: A decorative design or arrangement of shapes, colors, or lines.
The way something looks or seems; indications of a situation.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}{模様|もよう}の{布|ぬの}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought fabric with a floral pattern.

examples.japanese: {縞|しま}{模様|もよう}のシャツを{着|き}ている。
この{皿|さら}には{美|うつく}しい{水玉|みずたま}{模様|もよう}が{描|えが}かれている。
examples.english: This plate has a beautiful polka dot pattern painted on it.
examples.notes: 水玉模様 = polka dot pattern

examples.japanese: {空|そら}{模様|もよう}が{怪|あや}しい。
examples.notes: 空模様 = the look of the sky, weather conditions

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}{模様|もよう}なので{傘|かさ}を{持|も}っていこう。
examples.english: It looks like rain, so let's bring an umbrella.
examples.notes: 雨模様 = signs of rain, looking like rain

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}は{一方|いっぽう}{的|てき}な{展開|てんかい}{模様|もよう}で、ホームチームが{圧勝|あっしょう}した。
examples.english: The game took on a one-sided pattern, and the home team won a landslide victory.

notes:
USAGE: {模様|もよう} has two main uses: (1) decorative patterns, and (2) the appearance or state of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{花|はな}{模様|もよう} (floral pattern)
・{縞|しま}{模様|もよう} (striped pattern)
・{水玉|みずたま}{模様|もよう} (polka dot pattern)
・{空|そら}{模様|もよう} (the look of the sky)
・〜{模様|もよう}だ (it seems like ~)
